## Summary

Describe the change and its scientific or software motivation.

## Scientific integrity

- [ ] Tensor, sign, coordinate, and unit conventions are documented.
- [ ] Data provenance and reuse rights are documented where relevant.
- [ ] Numerical changes include an analytical, synthetic, or published benchmark.
- [ ] Limitations and uncertainty implications are described.

## Verification

- [ ] `ruff check .`
- [ ] `pytest`
- [ ] `python tools/validate_repository.py`
- [ ] `python -m build`
